title: [3/11/2024] The amount of tea and coffee imported
prompt: The graph below shows the amount of tea and coffee imported by four different countries. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main points and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The bar chart illustrates the quantities of tea and coffee imported by four different countries, measured in tonnes.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while the United Kingdom imported significantly more tea than the other three nations, Germany led in terms of coffee imports.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the countries with the most striking figures, the UK imported approximately 80,000 tonnes of tea, which was about twice the amount of coffee it brought in, at roughly 30,000 tonnes. Meanwhile, Germany's coffee imports reached around 50,000 tonnes, notably higher than its tea purchases of 40,000 tonnes.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining nations, both Canada and the US showed similar patterns in their imports. Their tea imports were almost identical at about 20,000 tonnes, while their coffee imports were also comparable at approximately 40,000 tonnes each, double the amount of their tea imports.
